reviewer: same-agent explicit code review, not independent human or subagent review
conclusions: Support labels are used for ridge and logistic fitting; query labels appear only in scoring and audit.
Inherited gamma is scaled by896/newdimension to preserve covariance operator under empty-coordinate padding; four real endpoint null checks passed.
Gallery conditions are averaged within each task before seed/domain-stratified paired bootstrap; 1000 unique tasks,2000 paired gallery conditions.
Strong controls receive the same fixed CLIP/baseDINO features, no method-specific view or identity advantage.
Six fixed views and RGB identities are reused; CPU/MPS parity check does not claim equality with an old base feature cache.
Full output scores saved for complete arithmetic audit; separate NumPy primary/scatter on four prespecified task99 cases.
Full extraction guarded by numerical and encoding prechecks; classifier guarded by feature validation. No label-dependent sweep.
limitations: Source datasets are development-exposed; even a passing source gate does not establish target advantage.
Different checkpoints change representation dimension and pretraining details, so no pure parameter-count causal claim.
Logistic solver is not independently reimplemented.
